positions.name: CompetentCalibrationEvidence
positions.frame: what counts as evidence that calibration work was done competently?
positions.why: Both expressions center verification against the June reference plates as the marker of competent calibration — src-2 asserts the verification as a completed collective act ('We verified the calibration against the June reference plates and it holds across the full observing band'), while src-3 ratifies the same verification as a settled key decision. The shared directional read is competence demonstrated through reference-standard verification; the tension between unhedged claim (src-2) and decision-log ratification (src-3) is the same fact read at two conviction levels.
